objective: Establish ContextBench as the quantitative evaluation gate for CLM shadow context policy before any production promotion discussion.

rulesConsidered: ContextFabric remains the sole working-context authority.
CLM is proposal-only and cannot mutate or commit active context directly.
Evaluation must distinguish technical validity, safety, and usefulness.
Held-out evidence is required before a candidate evaluation is admitted.
A benchmark result never grants production model-promotion authority.
